hook: Latency doesn't lie: Modaic fingerprints the Jev decision model
hookText: Latency doesn't lie: Modaic fingerprints the Jev decision model

beats.say: Modaic used self-identification probes, tokenizer-versus-latency fits over 9,984 prompts and prefill throughput comparisons to argue that TypeSafe's Jev is most likely a fine-tune of the Qwen3.5-35B-A3B mixture-of-experts model.

Qwen's tokenizer predicted Jev's latency better than Jev's own reported input-token counts, and controls with known backbones (Baseten's Gemma-based groundhog-1 and Modaic's Qwen-based Mo Lite) validated the method.
The authors note Qwen3.6-35B-A3B shares the architecture and cannot be ruled out by throughput alone.
